name: path
description: Outline part: a list of vertices in the layer's coordinates. A vertex is { x, y } (a corner) and may carry tangent handles relative to it: "in" (toward the previous vertex) and "out" (toward the next), each { x, y }. A vertex may have a name, unique in its part ({ x, y, name: "chin" }; elsewhere it is "jaw.chin"). A vertex may share a named point of another part of the same layer instead of having x, y: { ref: "jaw.chin", in?, out? } sits where jaw.chin is, so the two outlines are welded there and move together. closed joins the last vertex to the first; an open outline is usually a line (fill null).
help: Outline made of vertices with optional curve handles.

vertices.description: Vertices: [{ x, y, in?: { x, y }, out?: { x, y }, name? }] or a shared point [{ ref: "part.point", in?, out? }], handles relative to their vertex.

closed.description: If true, the last vertex joins the first one.
closed.help: Joins the last vertex to the first one.

holes.description: Holes cut out of a closed outline's fill (a ring, a donut): a list of closed outlines, each a list of vertices as in vertices (x, y with handles, or a shared point { ref }, and follow / way), but without names. A shape made by Create Shape (aia shape, aia fill) around lines that lie inside its gap gets one hole per group of them, each following it.
holes.help: Holes cut out of the fill (Create Shape makes them around shapes inside a gap).
